ratings_why.fun: Writing your own spell all game and pouring it onto a lamp unit with Drawn moths around it is a clear, rewarding growth story; the shared Recipe card is a lot to track but it is one card.
ratings_why.distinct: A spell-making tribe whose payoff can be another tribe's carry is fresh, and Drawn is a real positional idea, but 'your spells get stronger' echoes Battlegrounds Naga.

verdict_why: Two small rules gaps (keyword lines stacking, the Alchymist's numbered keywords) need one sentence each; the rest reads well.

points.text: Say whether a keyword line stacks: if the lamp gets three Phials with a Bristle 2 line, or two Cocoon Spinners both add Bristle 2, is that Bristle 2, 4 or 6?
The Alchymist copying a keyword with a number (Bristle N, Belly N, Damage Reduction N, Pass X) doesn't say which number goes on the line; say it copies the unit's current number.

The flavour lands well in play (Drawn to the lamp, Psyche's soul pouring out, Shipton's omen), but the eyespot bluff and the peppered moth's colour change have no card; a Start of Combat eyespot that makes an enemy attack a different target would fit.
Mortar Grinder's random Moth is the one generic card; aiming its growth at the unit that got the most Phials this turn would tie it to the Lamp.
Mother Shipton's loss depends on the target's size through spell scaling; showing the exact loss on the enemy card in the fight preview would make her readable.

standouts.why: Burnt Ring Warden makes the moth-round-the-lamp picture the actual play, and its text is one plain line.
Psyche, the soul that pours the Recipe onto her neighbours when she dies, is flavour and placement puzzle at once.
The Alchymist stealing other tribes' keywords into the Recipe is the most surprising card and the bridge's high roll.

weakest.why: Mortar Grinder is a generic random-buff engine with no moth in it.
Atropos is a shop discount; the honey-thief in disguise doesn't come through.
The Uncertain is a clear but plain gold card; the dose-doubt idea is only in the name.

flags.note: Dame Pavonia doubles both the stat casts and the cast counts for Carbonaria, Grinder and the Nurse; the compounding is worth the owner's eye.
Numbered keywords copied as a line have no stated number.
Repeat Bristle 2 lines, or repeat Phials carrying one, have no stacking rule.
